question.text: What is the Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) and how frequently is it issued?

answer.text: A physical certificate of holdings issued annually by each AMC separately
A single statement covering all mutual fund holdings across AMCs, issued monthly if there are transactions and half-yearly otherwise
A statement issued only on redemption showing capital gains and losses
A quarterly portfolio disclosure statement required by SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series V-A workbook (pp.171-172), CAS covers all mutual fund schemes across all fund houses linked to an investor's PAN. It is issued monthly to investors with transactions during the month, and half-yearly to investors with no transactions. The Trap: CAS is not the same as an individual AMC account statement. It is not redemption-only, and it is not a quarterly SEBI portfolio disclosure. Note: Keep the V-A scope: across all schemes of all mutual funds by PAN, monthly when transactions occur, half-yearly otherwise.
